text:
Tess: dropped a compact variant of the Credentials page — goal is to make token creation frictionless on small screens. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-credentials

Omar: looks promising. main concerns: copy clarity on rotate/revoke and how we communicate immediate vs delayed revokes. microcopy should be explicit but short.

Lucy: propose tiny inline helper next to CTAs: e.g., for rotate button add "(old token revoked immediately)" in muted text. keeps modal simpler.

Omar: agree. also suggest changing primary create CTA text from "Create token" to "Create token & show secret" to set expectations for first-time users.

Tess: I worry that CTA might be too long. maybe a short primary "Create token" and small secondary line below: "Secret will be shown once after creation. Save it now."

Lucy: sounds good. accessibility: ensure that secondary line is programmatically associated with the CTA via aria-describedby. screen reader users should hear the note when focusing the button.

Ops-bot: FYI — backend supports a configurable overlap window (0-60s) for rotate. default=0 for hosted.

Omar: suggestion: show an advanced toggle "Enable 30s overlap (for infra)" inside an accordion. hide it for free-tier seats.

Tess: done in mock. another tiny UX: when user copies token, change copy icon to a check and keep that state for 3s. avoids toasts.

Lucy: accessibility nit: ensure the check state is conveyed to assistive tech. use aria-live polite: "Copied to clipboard". also keyboard focus should remain on the copy button after action.

Ops-bot: audit events to track: token_created, token_shown, token_copied, token_rotated, token_revoked. include actor id and preset.

Omar: empty state: variant A uses an illustration + three quick examples; variant B is a minimal single-line CTA. Which to ship? For small screens I'd pick minimal A/B test.

Tess: let's A/B test minimal vs example cards. I'll add experiment flag and copy variants.

Lucy: final accessibility checklist: contrast 4.5:1 for any warning text, focusable undo toast, aria-labels for icons, live region for secret reveal, and accessible shortcuts help.

Tess: thanks all — I'll push updated frames with experiment variants and final copy table. pinging design-bot to upload frames.

Design-bot: Uploaded: Credentials - compact variants (tess/omar) — frames + copy table.

Omar: one last item: add a short inline doc link in empty state: "How scopes work" so users learn before creating overly-permissive tokens.

Lucy: agree. also add a tiny security banner on the page reminding org admins about rotation policies.

Tess: noted. thanks everyone!
